title: Pure Penguin
summary: Penguin monsters with generic WATER Synchros and staples; the page's Swordsoul, Ice Barrier, Ghoti and Mermail partners are left out. First Penguin, the newest card, summons itself as a Tuner and discards a card to reveal Penguin Brave and search a Level 5 Aqua, Penguin Squire or The Great Emperor Penguin. That locks the Extra Deck to WATER for the turn, so every Synchro here is WATER. Penguin Brave sets a Penguin from the Deck face-down and flips one on the opponent's turn. Penguin Soldier and Penguin Ninja bounce cards when flipped, and with Nopenguin on the field the bounced cards are banished instead. Penguin Squire lowers its Level, so the same hand reaches Level 6, 7 or 8.
main: First Penguin
Newest starter: summons itself as a Tuner, then reveals a WATER Synchro to search a Level 5 Aqua.
Penguin Squire
Level 5 Tuner: summons itself when a monster is Set; lowers its Level by 1 or 2.
The Great Emperor Penguin
Tributes itself to summon two Penguins from the Deck.
Glacial Beast Polar Penguin
Tuner: bounces a monster when summoned and a card when destroyed.
Penguin Soldier
FLIP: bounces up to two monsters.
Penguin Ninja
FLIP: bounces up to two Spells/Traps; turns a Penguin face-down again.
Nopenguin
Revives itself when a Penguin effect activates; turns Penguin bounces into banishes.
Penguin Cleric
Puts a Penguin your opponent sent to the GY back face-down.
Puny Penguin
Revives a Penguin when it leaves the field after flipping.
Nightmare Penguin
FLIP: bounces a card; pumps your WATER monsters.
Royal Penguins Garden
Searches any Penguin card and lowers a Penguin's Level.
Penguin Sword
Equip: negates copies of the cards your Penguins bounce or banish.
extra: Level 6: sets a Penguin from the Deck and flips one on their turn; First Penguin's reveal target.
Generic WATER Level 6: discards to destroy a card.
Generic WATER Level 6: discards to bounce a card on the field.
Generic WATER Level 7 Tuner: fetches a Level 4 or lower Penguin from the Deck by returning a card Nopenguin banished.
Generic WATER Level 8: discards to turn an opposing monster into a Continuous Trap.
